<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple header (model header@1): the brand as the link home, the navigation links as a list in a nav and
  one action. No menu button: the links wrap under the brand on a narrow screen. Axes: layout (inline: the links
  in the middle, end: the links beside the action, centered: the brand over the links).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HeaderLink } from "./header-simple.types";

  export type HeaderSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    brand: string;
    brandHref: string;
    links: HeaderLink[];
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    layout?: "inline" | "end" | "centered";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    brand,
    brandHref,
    links,
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    layout = "inline",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: HeaderSimpleProps = $props();
  const frame = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "centered" ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-4"
    : "flex flex-col items-start gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between"
  );
  const bar = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "inline" ? "md:grow md:justify-between"
    : (layout as string) === "centered" ? "justify-center"
    : "md:justify-end"
  );
  const nav = $derived(((layout as string) === "inline") ? "md:grow" : "");
  const linkRow = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "inline" ? "md:justify-center"
    : (layout as string) === "centered" ? "justify-center"
    : ""
  );
</script>

<Block tag="header" class="py-4" aria-label={landmarkLabel} data-slot="header-simple">
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box class={frame}>
      <LinkPlain href={urlOf(brandHref)} class="text-foreground hover:text-primary">
        <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
          {brand}
        </Text>
      </LinkPlain>
      <Group gap="6" align="center" class={cn("flex-wrap", bar)}>
        <Box class={nav}>
          <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", cn("flex flex-wrap gap-6", linkRow))}>
            {#each links as l (l.id)}
              <ListItem data-slot="nav-link">
                <LinkPlain href={urlOf(l.href)} class="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
                  <Text size="sm">
                    {l.label}
                  </Text>
                </LinkPlain>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </Box>
        {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
          <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
            {actionLabel}
          </LinkButton>
        {/if}
      </Group>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
